sections.h2: The obligatory cession fell from roughly 20% to 4% and has held there since FY2022-23

chart.title: Each step cut the share GIC Re is guaranteed; 4% has held for three years
chart.sub: Share of every general insurance policy ceded to GIC Re, %.
chart.source: IRDAI notifications as reported by Business Standard and The Tribune.

sections.means: The rate stepped down from roughly 20% to 4%, and IRDAI has confirmed 4% for FY2026-27 as well.
sections.todo: Do not read a change to the 4% rate as a change to what a PMFBY claimant receives.

sections.h2: Farmers fund only 1.5-5% of PMFBY premiums; the state pays the rest

chart.title: Farmers pay 1.5-5% of the capped premium; the Centre and states pay 95-98.5%
chart.sub: Farmer's capped premium share, by crop category, %.

sections.means: PMFBY is structurally much closer to a government subsidy routed through insurers than to insurance as most people understand it.
sections.todo: Judge PMFBY's claim totals against the public premium that funded them, not against farmers' payments.

sections.h2: Precision-farming yield gains range from 10-15% to 25-35% by study type

chart.title: Drone studies show 10-15% gains; NITI-documented pilots show 25-35%
chart.sub: Reported yield gain, %. Vendor marketing claims are left out.
chart.source: Leher.ag; India Mongabay; NITI Aayog Frontier Tech.

sections.means: Reported gains differ widely by who measured them, so no single yield figure is the expected gain from precision farming.
sections.todo: Ask for independent measurement before relying on the 25-35% pilot figures.
